path_to_1M.today: the latent pool (and pool keys) is replicated on all 4 dies: 11,968 B per token per die
path_to_1M.sequence-sharded latent: blocks of the paged pool distributed over the 4 dies (block b on die b % 4): 2,992 B per token per die -> ~4x tokens (~420K at 1 slot with today's free DRAM). Decode: each die runs the indexer on its own pool keys, all-gathers its top candidates (512 x 4 scores), selects the global top-512 pools, attends its local share of the selected tokens and returns (o, lse) partials; one cross-die LSE combine per DSA layer (the flash-decode merge). Prefill: the chunk's latent rows scatter to their home die; sparse_sdpa on per-die index lists + the same LSE merge. Cost: two small CCLs per DSA layer per step.
path_to_1M.plus bfp8 latent (TILE, 544 B vs 1024 B: 1,672 B per token per die with sharding -> ~760K tokens
path_to_1M.plus host embedding lookup (frees 317 MB: ~1.0M tokens at 1 slot (1,048,576 x 1,672 B = 1.75 GB per die)

path_to_1M.block-sharded latent (implemented, stage: MCOpts.dsa_shard / GLM53_DSA_SHARD=1 (tt/dsa_shard.py): global block b on die b % 4, 544-wide rows (latent + control columns for the cross-die softmax merge), pool keys / indexer / top-512 replicated: 3,696 B per token per die (473,088 B per 128-token block over 11 layers). Measured 1-slot capacity probe: 2199 blocks, 281,283-token prompt + 24 decode steps, copy 24/24, 335 MB free at the prefill peak (doc/multichip_decoder/dsa_shard/capacity/). Cost: decode +~0.41 ms per DSA layer per step.
